items.title: Broadcom’s AI Success Story Gets Complicated
items.summary: Broadcom  might be the biggest winner from the AI-chip craze after  Nvidia  with a growing roster of large customers and $100 billion of revenue projected for that segment of its business in its next fiscal year.  Broadcom came into the AI boom as a hodgepodge of chip and software businesses assembled by Chief Executive  Hock Tan.  Google changed the game at the boom’s outset.
